mapper.select: SELECT R.*, U.NAME AS RECEPTIONIST_NAME FROM MYBATIS_RECEIPT R LEFT JOIN MYBATIS_TABLE U ON R.RECEPTIONIST_ID = U.ID WHERE R.ID = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MYBATIS_RECEIPT ( REQUEST_ID, TITLE, CONTENTS, RECEIPT_DATE, STATUS, RECEPTIONIST_ID ) VALUES ( #{requestId}, #{title}, #{contents}, #{receiptDate}, #{status}, #{receptionistId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE MYBATIS_RECEIPT SET REQUEST_ID = #{requestId}, TITLE = #{title}, CONTENTS = #{contents}, RECEIPT_DATE = #{receiptDate}, STATUS = #{status}, RECEPTIONIST_ID = #{receptionistId} WHERE ID = #{id}
